flowRoot.flowPara: The basis of the Toolbx logo is the hexagon wrench button.
It can be used standalone with no type.
Multiple shades of lightness are allowed as accent color for backdrops for the monochrome variant of the logo.
The purple button can only be used on white and very light grey backgrounds. For high frequency/detail or dark backgournds, use black/white silhouette.
Whitespace is not wasted space. Provide emphasis by giving the logotype some space.
The font used in the logotype is Inter.
